args: go telemetry off && [ "$(go telemetry)" = "off" ] || { echo "Failed to disable Go telemetry"; exit 1; }
apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends            ca-certificates            curl            jq
xx-apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends             gcc             libc6-dev             linux-libc-dev             pkg-config

set -ex
  CC=$(xx-info)-gcc cmake .
  make tini-static
  xx-verify --static tini-static
  mkdir /build
  mv tini-static /build/docker-init
apt-get update && xx-apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends             gcc             libc6-dev             linux-libc-dev             libseccomp-dev             pkg-config

set -e
  xx-go --wrap

  target=runc
  verify_flags=
  if [ "$DOCKER_STATIC" = "1" ]; then
    target=static
    verify_flags=--static
  fi

  set -x
  CGO_ENABLED=1 make RUNC_BUILDTAGS="-libpathrs" "$target"
  xx-verify $verify_flags runc
  mkdir /build
  mv runc /build/
apt-get update && xx-apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends             gcc             pkg-config

set -e

  make_flags=
  verify_flags=
  cgo_enabled=1
  if [ "$DOCKER_STATIC" = "1" ]; then
      make_flags=STATIC=1
      verify_flags=--static
      cgo_enabled=0
  fi

  set -x
  xx-go --wrap
  CC="$(xx-info)-gcc" CGO_ENABLED=$cgo_enabled make $make_flags binaries
  xx-verify $verify_flags bin/containerd
  xx-verify $verify_flags bin/containerd-shim-runc-v2
  xx-verify $verify_flags bin/ctr
  mkdir /build
  mv bin/containerd bin/containerd-shim-runc-v2 bin/ctr /build
apt-get update && xx-apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends             gcc             libc6-dev             linux-libc-dev             pkg-config

set -e

  if [ "$DOCKER_STATIC" = "1" ]; then
      set -x
      export CGO_ENABLED=0
      xx-go build -o /build/rootlesskit ./cmd/rootlesskit
      xx-verify --static /build/rootlesskit
  else
      set -x
      export CGO_ENABLED=1
      xx-go build -o /build/rootlesskit -ldflags='-linkmode=external' ./cmd/rootlesskit
      xx-verify /build/rootlesskit
  fi

apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends             autoconf             automake             build-essential             libcap-dev             libjson-c-dev             libprotobuf-c-dev             libseccomp-dev             libsystemd-dev             libtool             pkgconf             python3             ;
useradd --create-home --gid docker unprivilegeduser  && mkdir -p /home/unprivilegeduser/.local/share/docker  && chown -R unprivilegeduser /home/unprivilegeduser

apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends             apparmor             bash-completion             bzip2             e2fsprogs             fuse-overlayfs             inetutils-ping             iproute2             iptables             nftables             jq             libcap2-bin             libnet1             libnftables-dev             libnl-3-200             libprotobuf-c1             libyajl2             nano             net-tools             netcat-openbsd             patch             pigz             sudo             systemd-journal-remote             thin-provisioning-tools             uidmap             vim             vim-common             xfsprogs             xz-utils             zip             zstd
apt-get update && apt-get install --no-install-recommends -y             gcc             pkg-config             libseccomp-dev             libsystemd-dev             yamllint
